faq_heading: Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 38 schools with a Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows street address: 33 public schools and 5 independent schools.
Public schools here are run by School District 42 (Maple Ridge-Pitt Meadows). Count by district: School District 42 (Maple Ridge-Pitt Meadows): 33.

The list includes alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address, so the totals run higher than the number of neighbourhood schools. The Ministry's own level field also mislabels some secondary schools as elementary, so this page reads the level from the school's name.

If you are buying with a child in mind, the address matters more than the list. A school's catchment decides which children it must take, and districts change catchments and set their own rules for French immersion and other programs. Ask the district about the exact address before you write an offer.
Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows are separate cities served by one school district, so they share this list and the Community column shows which city each school is in.

blocks.text: Licensed childcare in Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows

The Ministry's Child Care Map registry lists 189 licensed childcare facilities with a Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows address: 105 licensed group and 84 licensed family. The registry covers licensed care only. Care that does not need a licence is not listed by address, so a family may find more options than this count suggests. Names and addresses change often, so check the registry before you rely on any one facility.

faq.q: How many schools are in Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 38 schools with a Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows street address: 33 public schools and 5 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: Public schools with a Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows address are run by School District 42 (Maple Ridge-Pitt Meadows).

faq.q: How do I find which school a home is zoned for?
faq.a: Ask the school district to confirm the catchment school for the exact street address. Catchments change, and living near a school does not guarantee a place at it.
